## 型

### Instant

```emela
opaque type Instant
```

A point in time. The current one is returned by `Clock.now`.

## 値

### from_unix_milliseconds

```emela
fn from_unix_milliseconds(ms: Int64) -> Instant
```

Negative values are before the epoch.

### to_unix_milliseconds

```emela
fn to_unix_milliseconds(t: Instant) -> Int64
```

Milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Negative before the epoch.

### add

```emela
fn add(t: Instant, d: Duration) -> Instant
```

Earlier if `d` is negative.

### subtract

```emela
fn subtract(t: Instant, d: Duration) -> Instant
```

`d` earlier. Later if `d` is negative.

### since

```emela
fn since(t: Instant, earlier: Instant) -> Duration
```

The duration from `earlier` to `t`; negative if `earlier` is later.
Reads as `now.since(start)`.

### to_string

```emela
fn to_string(t: Instant) -> String
```

The date and time in UTC (`2026-10-12T03:04:05.678Z`), an RFC 3339 `date-time` for years 0 to
9999. Other years are written with a sign and at least six digits (`+010000`, `-000001`), the
expanded year of ISO 8601. The format is in spec `[api.std.instant]`.

### parse

```emela
fn parse(s: String) -> Instant fails ParseError
```

The point in time written in `s`: a date and time with an offset from UTC, in the form that
`to_string` writes, the `date-time` of RFC 3339, and a few more (`2025-10-12 12:04:05.678+09`).
The offset is required. Fails with `ParseError(input: s)` otherwise. The grammar is in spec
`[api.std.instant]`.
